description: H09 migrates the 38 active TerminalApp FZF source contracts to a real Rust terminal-app owner. The one Microsoft-ignored multi-code-point full-fold contract remains Missing; SettingsModel, Control, JsonUtils, and LocalTerminalApp ownership are otherwise unchanged.
